idle.meaningful_phase_review: Sixteen full-cycle samples, retimed to125ms/frame (~2.0s) for a readable but active battle/overworld idle loop.

move.meaningful_phase_review: Active reciprocal gait interval37–87 with near-matched endpoints; 26 samples retimed to42ms/frame (~1.09s per loop), no standing intro/outro.

attack.meaningful_phase_review: Ready frame24, anticipation frames32–52, peak forward head/antler lunge/contact at56 (still at peak through60), then recovery through92. Retimed to70ms/frame for a ~1.19s tactical strike.

hit.meaningful_phase_review: Starts at clean recoil/impact frame52 after detached incoming artifact disappears; 12 samples through ready settle at96, retimed60ms/frame (~0.72s), excludes trailing hold.

defend.meaningful_phase_review: Transition samples0–36 plus final guard123; retimed70ms/frame (~0.70s), final pose persistent static guard.

death.meaningful_phase_review: Starts ready, then buckles/falls frame40 through grounded corpse96; samples fast collapse64–88, retimed83ms/frame (~1.33s), final corpse persistent.

cast.meaningful_phase_review: Ready12; planted chest/head rise16-40; proud antler rally peak40-72; recovery80-108. Original-only endpoints, no generated middle guide. Uneven source intervals retain proportional holds at 0.36x source duration; 1500ms gesture.
